title: 65. Can I receive a reminder of when my survey will end?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: Can I receive a reminder of when my survey will end.
short_answer: EUSurvey can send you an email reminder when your survey is about to end. This allows you to prepare the next steps (e.g. organising resources for result analysis).
procedure: To enable this option, open the survey and go to the 'Properties' page. Select 'Advanced Settings' section and, click on the 'Edit' button and enable 'End Notification', specifying how long in advance you expect an email. Click on 'Save'. The reminder email will be delivered to all form managers
